title: adjust_test_app returns App BY VALUE — the embedded self-pointers (app.view.palette, app.input.view, app.input.user) still reference the callee's dead frame and are never re-bound after the copy
evidence:
adjust_test_app :: proc(t: ^testing.T) -> (app: App, path: string) {
	app.palette_base = rnd.palette_load()
	app.palette = app.palette_base
	app.view.palette = &app.palette
	app.view.win_w = 1280
	app.view.win_h = 720
	app.view.ui_scale = 1.0
	app.input.view = &app.view
	app.input.user = &app
	path = tmp_settings_path(t)
	app.settings_path_override = path
	return
}
detail: Odin copies the struct on return; the caller's `app` carries pointers into adjust_test_app's popped frame. The four adjust legs survive only because effect_settings_adjust never dereferences ictx.view/ictx.user — any added settings_press/view read reads garbage non-deterministically.
recommended_fix: Re-bind after copy in the caller (app.view.palette = &app.palette; app.input.view = &app.view; app.input.user = &app) or return ^App allocated in the temp allocator.

title: a11y_separation_check routes the 48-vs-40 threshold on pr[0] color-VALUE equality, not pair identity — a signal pair whose endpoint coincides with water/park/coast/canvas mis-routes to the 40 threshold
detail: Threshold routing keys on the pair's first color value; the state-triad/lanes/ghost/pipe pairs carry no identity tag, so a value collision with a map token silently relaxes the check.
recommended_fix: Key the threshold on a pair-class tag appended with each pair (signal vs map), not on color equality. Carry: still present since round 1.

title: Demo a11y parser accepts and silently ignores trailing tokens after 'a11y reduced' and 'a11y palette <mode>' — a typo like 'a11y palette deutan extra' rides along
detail: The scale sub-branch validates fields exhaustively; the reduced/palette branches never check len(fields), so garbage suffix tokens are accepted without error.
recommended_fix: Assert the exact field count for each a11y sub-form. Carry: still present since round 6.

title: Deutan and protan mode tables are byte-identical in data/palette.json — the two CVD modes render identically; the derive script hard-codes identical anchors for both
evidence: derive(): remap["state_healthy"]   = teal ... remap["state_healthy"] = teal (no mode == "deutan" vs "protan" branch; only tritan diverges); palette.json modes.deutan == modes.protan token-for-token
detail: Class-level tuning is plausible but unruled; a protan player gets the deutan table with no independent verification surface.
recommended_fix: Restyle protan per its own simulation or document the class-level-tuning decision. Carry: still present since round 6.
